philosophy.title: Design Philosophy
philosophy.subtitle: The principles behind every decision I make.

principles.title: Clarity over cleverness
principles.body: Good design should feel obvious — not because it's simple, but because it's well-structured and thoughtfully considered.

principles.title: Solve the right problem first
principles.body: Visual polish matters, but only after layout, hierarchy, and usability are resolved. Every decision should earn its place.

principles.title: Design for how people actually read
principles.body: Users scan, they don't study. Clear hierarchy, predictable layouts, and familiar patterns let people act with confidence and minimal effort.

principles.title: Think in systems, not screens
principles.body: Consistent components, spacing rules, and type scales improve the experience for users and the velocity of the team building it.

principles.title: Iterate toward better
principles.body: Design is a continuous process — sharpened through feedback, iteration, and contact with the real world.
